verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no llms.txt or agent-targeted documentation, and the probe for a Markdown docs endpoint returned HTTP 404. Markdown style files and an extension guide are adjacent features, not docs meant for an agent to consume.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
